description: Ask to read a paid web page. Returns a link the USER must open to approve the payment in their own wallet - show the link and the price to the user and wait. Then call get_paid_page with the request_id. Nothing is paid without the user approving it.

access_tokens.description: Access tokens exactly as get_paid_page gave them (host|token|seal). Each is sent only to the site it was given for; others are ignored.

max_price.description: The most to pay for this page, in USDC, e.g. "0.10". Required, after asking the user, for anything above a few USDC (a subscription).

name: request_paid_page
